name: Mrs. M. Liebmann
mentions: Mrs. M. Liebmann, of Deadwood, came Monday night and was a guest at Rassie Deffebach's until yesterday morning, when she started for home on the coach.
…B. McDonough, F. Smith, Wing Foo, Mrs. Buck, Mrs. Hawley, W. W. Driskill, K. P. Aldis. Departures are Mrs. M. Liebman, A. L. Gossage, Wm. Luce, Orrin Kinley, D. Robinson, A. Adams.
